description: This file defines the CustomerOption entity class, representing customer options or attributes in the system. It includes fields like code, type, active status, and relationships to descriptions and merchant store, with associated JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer option with properties like code, type, status, and relationships to descriptions and merchant store.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of descriptions associated with this customer option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions associated with this customer option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier of the customer option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the customer option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this customer option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Assigns a merchant store to this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list, converting from the set if necessary.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Ensures the descriptions list is populated from the set and returns it.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the customer option.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the customer option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the unique code identifier for the customer option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code identifier for the customer option.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the customer option is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the customer option.

methods.name: isPublicOption
methods.description: Checks if the customer option is public.

methods.name: setPublicOption
methods.description: Sets whether the customer option is public.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the customer option.
